title: Hand pose
description: Finger bends for one hand pose, in radians, with the hand's position and, for a sign that moves, the later steps of the movement. Written for a right hand; a left hand mirrors it. See POSE_FORMAT.md.

pinky.description: Positive tilts toward the pinky side

thumb.description: About the thumb's length; positive turns the pad toward the fingers

wrist.description: Whole-hand rotation, applied twist, then tilt, then turn, about the middle of the hand. All zero is upright with the palm facing the viewer.

turn.description: In the palm's plane; positive toward the pinky side, ±π points the fingers down

tilt.description: Positive tips the fingers toward the palm side

twist.description: About the forearm; positive turns the palm toward the thumb side

motion.description: The steps of a movement after the first (the pose's own fields), in order. An empty list is a still pose.

duration.description: Milliseconds to move from the step before into this one

still.description: The whole hand at one step: the same fields as a pose, without version or motion

move.description: Whole-hand position in hand lengths (wrist to middle fingertip), in the signer's directions. All zero is the resting place.

side.description: Positive moves out, away from the body's middle

fingerRotate.description: About the finger's length, from the base knuckle; positive turns the pad toward the thumb side

finger.description: [base, middle, tip] bend; 0 is straight, positive curls toward the palm
